blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V154 renders: front, back and side still read as broad flared panels with only weak isolated ridges; the pleat rhythm is not clearly legible at product scale and the hem remains rigid.
The 60 mm thigh-shell cutback remains in the generated geometry; direct crouch and sit renders still show broad, hard-edged upper-thigh panels at the front opening. Pose coverage is not demonstrated.
Front, side, back and arm-cross renders retain pinched triangular facets and abrupt surface transitions over torso, hip and waist panels; these remain visible garment geometry defects.
The prone render remains a collapsed overlap of limbs and garment panels, with the skirt presenting rigid lobes rather than plausible drape. This required pose remains visually unacceptable.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
